alt: A fine pointed tool forming tiny white letters on a dark lined surface
title: Letters at a tiny scale
story: Rows of tiny characters cover a dark surface. The clip brings the fine tool, close spacing and repeated hand movements into view.

alt: A sculptor using a mallet and chisel on a large wooden figure with folded drapery
title: Drapery carved in wood
story: A mallet and chisel work along the folds of a large wooden sculpture. The unfinished surface reveals how carved lines become fabric-like forms.

alt: Hands sanding a carved wooden dog with upright ears
title: A face shaped in wood
story: Hands refine the cheeks and muzzle of a wooden dog sculpture. Carved texture and gentle sanding bring the form into focus.

alt: A large circular polished metal sculpture standing in a workshop
title: A circle in polished metal
story: Polished metal reflects the workshop around a circular sculpture. Curved forms and small figures occupy its interior.

alt: A worker shaping a large metal wire sculpture in a workshop
title: Lines becoming a figure
story: Bent metal lines gather into a large sculptural figure. The clip follows the workshop process and the structure taking shape.
